data.name: Speaker Accent Recognition
data.abstract: Data set featuring single English words read by speakers from six different countries for accent detection and recognition

additional_info.variable_info:
Response variable: 
language = {ES, FR, GE, IT, UK, US} The six possible accents considered

Explanatory variables:
X1, X2, ..., X12 Obtained using MFCC on the original time domain soundtrack of the maximum 1s of reading of a word
